title: My wife and I are building a little world together. It’s slowly becoming an everything game.
author: randomforest99
selftext:
This is lilwrld, something my wife and I have been building together.

One of the nicest things about it has been having something to create together. Spending time talking about ideas, imagining what could be there, then actually getting to walk around in it. Making things has always been a huge part of my life, and sharing that with her makes this project pretty special to me.

And yes, we’re terrible at keeping the scope small. There’s racing, town building, flying, robots, mechs, Spider-Man-like swinging around. All in this tiny garden world where the grass towers over you and everyday objects become places to explore or things to drive.

It probably sounds like too much. It might be. But we genuinely want to build a world with all these things in it, somewhere we can keep adding the stuff we dream up.

Underneath it is our own custom game engine (I used to work on commercial game engines, just this one is my own). AI is a big part of how I’m building the code and the asset pipeline, with a lot of testing, rejecting designs and trying again. This is not a simple prompt but 100s of hours of custom pipelines for everything from characters, assets, rigging, animation, physics and other stuff. What excites me about that is being able to take more of those ideas out of our heads and actually make them playable.

There’s something really lovely about looking around a place that didn’t exist until the two of you started imagining it.

Still early, still rough in places. Here’s a little wander through what we have so far.
